Commissioners Absent: Caranci, Van Meeveren, Schwerin, Tejani

Also present: Anissa Davis, City Health Officer, Alejandra Gutierrez, Executive Assistant.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55756  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Health and Human
  Services meeting on Friday, June 13, 2025.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Walton, seconded by Member Clark, to
  approve recommendation. The motion by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Barrios, Clark, Gupta, McNeeley, Sanders, Walton, Lesen
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 4  Caranci, Van Meeveren, Schwerin, Tejani

2.  25-55757  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly report from the Director of Health
  and Human Services.

  Dr. Anissa Davis, City Health Officer, provided an update on behalf of Alison King,
  Director of Health and Human Services. The update consisted of Federal
  Government appointments, policy changes, budget changes, immigration, and
  Health Department staff.
